thread:
morgan.lee: FYI postmortem action items dug up a bunch of 'audit debt' tied to token validation + expired secret handling. proposing a small focused sprint to clear high-risk items.
anya.k: +1. can you list the high-risk ones so we can scope?
samir: Quick list from the PM notes: 1) token validation TTL mismatch between services -> causes 401 cascades, 2) missing audit events for service-to-service token exchanges, 3) secrets rotation job sometimes leaves stale creds in vault, 4) a few permission mappings where admin flags weren't propagated.
jordan: Oof. Are any of those immediate outage risks or more medium-term security gaps?
morgan.lee: The TTL mismatch caused last week's user-facing 401 spike, so high risk. Missing audit events are medium-high for compliance (could block SOC review). Stale creds are high (expiring but still accepted for a window). Permission mapping is medium.
anya.k: OK. propose we call this the "audit-debt offboarding sprint" and run 2 weeks with 3 core owners. Owners: token validation -> samir, audit events -> anya.k, secrets rotation -> jordan. Permission mapping -> morgan.lee. Can owners ack?
samir: ack. I'll start a small infra PR to standardize TTL lookup order and add a feature flag to roll it.
anya.k: ack. I'll draft the audit-event schema and a lightweight shim to emit missing events for service tokens, plus tests.
jordan: ack. I'll add a post-rotation probe to the rotation job that checks vault and cache for stale creds and retry cleanup.
morgan.lee: ack. I'll own mapping fix + rollout plan; will coordinate canary with Dedicated region.
ops-bot: Reminder set: #incident-sprints weekly cadence -> first sync @2026-04-02T16:00:00Z.
anya.k: Proposed milestones: week1: small fixes + tests for token TTL and audit shim; week2: secrets cleanup probe, permission mapping rollout, end-to-end validation. Risk buffer for hotfix day. Thoughts?
samir: sounds reasonable. For token TTL I need a compatibility fallback to avoid breaking older clients; prefer feature-flagged deploy first.
jordan: agree. rotation probe can run in dry-run mode first. need a test harness to simulate stale creds.
morgan.lee: I'll own the canary gate and rollback playbook. Add these action items to the postmortem tracker.
anya.k: Putting a short checklist here for tracker paste: 
```
- [ ] Token TTL: standardize lookup order (owner: samir) - due 2026-04-08
- [ ] Token TTL: feature flag + canary (owner: samir) - due 2026-04-09
- [ ] Audit shim: emit missing S2S events (owner: anya.k) - due 2026-04-08
- [ ] Secrets rotation: probe + cleanup (owner: jordan) - due 2026-04-12
- [ ] Permission mapping: propagate admin flags + tests (owner: morgan.lee) - due 2026-04-12
- [ ] End-to-end validation run + compliance sign-off (owner: anya.k) - due 2026-04-14
```

samir: I'll open PRs and link here as I go. linking a quick snippet for TTL fallback I plan to add: 
```go
// getTokenTTL reads canonical TTL then service override then default
func getTokenTTL(s ServiceConfig) time.Duration {
  if s.CanonicalTTL > 0 { return s.CanonicalTTL }
  if s.OverrideTTL > 0 { return s.OverrideTTL }
  return DefaultTTL
}
```

anya.k: nice. Also let's add audit log queries we'll use for regression checks. I can provide queries to detect missing S2S events across the last 90 days.
morgan.lee: Important: make sure perms fix includes a migration plan for older resources. We'll schedule migration during low-traffic window.
jordan: We should flag any related runbooks to update after fixes. ops-bot can you add runbook-update reminder for owners?
ops-bot: Reminder added: runbook-update -> 2026-04-15 assigned to [samir, anya.k, jordan, morgan.lee].
anya.k: One more: recurring incident pattern note — token-related 401 spikes show up roughly every 6-8 months in our logs. let's add a quarterly audit to the security calendar to prevent drift.
morgan.lee: Agreed. Add recurring task: token health audit every 90 days.
samir: Can someone triage which services have nonstandard TTLs so I can start? I can run a quick query if you give me a list.
anya.k: I'll export the config diff today and drop it here.
morgan.lee: Great. I'll create the sprint board and assign items. We'll do a short sync tomorrow to kick off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
